title: The Wayfarer
intro: You wake on the deck of the SS Wayfarer, a small freighter drifting dead in space. Emergency lighting bathes everything in dim red. Main power is offline, life support is on reserve, and the ship is silent. Restore power and get off this ship.
win_epilogue: You strap in and pull the launch lever. Clamps release with a thud, and the pod kicks free of the Wayfarer. Through the porthole, the dark freighter shrinks against the stars. You made it.

crew_quarters.name: Crew Quarters
crew_quarters.description: Narrow bunks line the walls of the cramped crew quarters. Red emergency light pulses from a strip above the hatch. A corridor lies to the east.
crew_quarters.alt_description: The crew quarters are brightly lit again. Your bunk looks almost inviting. A corridor lies to the east.
crew_quarters.sounds: Nothing but your own breathing and the tick of cooling metal somewhere behind the bulkhead.
crew_quarters.alt_sounds: The air recyclers hum, and somewhere aft a pump cycles on and off.

corridor.name: Main Corridor
corridor.description: The main corridor runs the length of the ship. In the red emergency glow you can make out a status console set into the wall. The crew quarters are west, the cargo bay east, the engine room south. To the north, a heavy door leads to the escape pod bay.
corridor.alt_description: White light floods the corridor and the air recyclers hum steadily. The crew quarters are west, the cargo bay east, the engine room south, and the escape pod bay door is north.

north.pass_message: You step over the sill into the pod bay. The air in here is colder, and very still.

corridor.sounds: The corridor is dead quiet. Every sound you make goes the whole length of it and comes back.
corridor.alt_sounds: Fans, the steady hum of restored power, and the corridor lights ticking as they warm.

cargo_bay.name: Cargo Bay
cargo_bay.description: Cargo netting and strapped-down containers fill the bay. A squat maintenance droid stands motionless near a large supply crate.
cargo_bay.sounds: Cargo netting shifts very slightly against the containers. Nothing else.
cargo_bay.alt_sounds: Air moving through the bay, and the netting creaking gently against the containers.

engine_room.name: Engine Room
engine_room.description: The engine room is dead quiet. The reactor housing looms cold and dark. A rack of tools hangs by the hatch.
engine_room.sounds: Silence, which is the wrong sound for an engine room, and the loudest thing in the ship.
engine_room.alt_sounds: The reactor housing stays cold and silent, but the room around it has come back to life: fans, relays, the whole ship's business.

escape_pod_bay.name: Escape Pod Bay
escape_pod_bay.description: A single escape pod sits in its launch cradle, hatch open. A launch lever juts from the console beside it.

south.pass_message: You duck back out into the corridor.

escape_pod_bay.sounds: The pod's hull ticks as it sits in the cradle. Beyond it, nothing at all — that side is hull, and then vacuum.
escape_pod_bay.alt_sounds: The pod's systems murmur to themselves in the cradle, waiting.

pod_door.name: pod bay door
pod_door.description: A heavy pressure door with magnetic seals, marked ESCAPE POD BAY.
pod_door.locked_message: You haul on the pod bay door, but its magnetic seals hold fast. Without main power, it won't budge.
pod_door.open_message: The lock plate goes green and the pod bay door grinds back into its housing, stiff from however long it has been sitting shut in the cold.

emergency_manual.name: emergency manual
emergency_manual.description: SS WAYFARER EMERGENCY PROCEDURES. Section 4: In case of main power failure, the maintenance droid R-6 can reroute auxiliary power. R-6 requires a charged power cell. Spare cells are stored in the cargo bay supply crate.

status_console.name: status console
status_console.description: MAIN POWER: OFFLINE. LIFE SUPPORT: RESERVE. ESCAPE POD: SEALED.
status_console.alt_description: MAIN POWER: ONLINE. LIFE SUPPORT: NOMINAL. ESCAPE POD: READY.

prybar.name: prybar
prybar.description: A meter of solid steel with a flattened end. Good for opening things that don't want to open.

reactor.name: reactor
reactor.description: The main reactor is cold. Its primary cells are slagged — this thing isn't restarting without a full service dock. Auxiliary power routing would be a job for the maintenance droid.

supply_crate.name: supply crate
supply_crate.description: A sealed cargo crate stenciled SPARES — POWER CELLS. The lid is jammed shut.
supply_crate.alt_description: The crate stands open, packing foam scattered around it.
supply_crate.open_refusal: You work your fingers under the lid and heave. It does not give — the crate is banded shut and jammed hard. Bare hands are not going to do it; something with leverage might.

open_refusal_with.prybar: You get a grip on the lid and pull, with about as much effect as before — then remember the prybar you are carrying. That flattened end is exactly what this needs.

power_cell.name: power cell
power_cell.description: A sealed energy cell, humming faintly and glowing pale blue along its charge strips.

launch_lever.name: launch lever
launch_lever.description: A heavy manual release lever. Pull it and the pod launches — no countdown, no second chances.

escape_pod.name: escape pod
escape_pod.description: A one-person pod, cramped but flight-ready. The launch lever beside it fires the release.

maintenance_droid.name: maintenance droid
maintenance_droid.description: A squat utility droid, model R-6. Its chest port — sized for a standard power cell — is empty, and its optics are dark.

dialogue.text: The droid is dark and unresponsive. An empty power socket gapes in its chest.
R-6 boots with a rising whir. 'Unit R-6 online. Diagnostic: main reactor offline. Rerouting auxiliary power… done. Main power restored, Captain. The escape pod bay is now accessible.'
R-6 beeps politely. 'Recommend immediate evacuation via escape pod, Captain.'

interactions.message: You wedge the prybar under the crate lid and heave. The lid pops off, revealing a power cell glowing softly in its packing foam.
You slot the power cell into the droid's chest port. It clicks home, and lights flicker up across the droid's chassis.

You work through the cold-start sequence from memory. Nothing answers: no hum, no warmth, not even a fault light on the housing. The primary cells really are slagged. Whatever gets you off this ship, it will not be this.
If you want to use the escape pod, you'll need to go into it.
